Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we can lock the 30-minute intro/demo and make sure the right folks are on the call.

Recap (high level):
- You’re evaluating an inference platform to reduce per-token cost and get predictable low-latency inference for various models (customer-facing chat + internal batch runs).
- Key constraints: strict data residency for PII workflows, SSO via Okta, and a relatively small set of models to start (1-2).
- Success criteria: sub-200ms 95th latency for chat at pilot volume, and a clear plan for audit logs and retention.

Proposed next meeting (30 min) — please pick one of these slots and confirm which technical stakeholders will attend (we’ll include an SE and a short tech agenda):
- Option A: Thu Jun 17, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Option B: Fri Jun 18, 1:00–1:30 PM PT
- Option C: Mon Jun 21, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

Pre-reads and ask for you:
- If there are any network/firewall requirements or example request volumes we should see ahead of time, paste them into the shared folder below.
- If you want us to walk through a specific dataset or API shape, let us know and we’ll tailor the demo.
